```{r libraries}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(DT)
```

```{r helpers}
parse_incentive <- function(path) {
  as.numeric(str_match(path, "resultsincentive([0-9.]+)")[,2])
}

user_to_u <- function(user) {

  income <- str_match(user, "amount([0-9]+)")[,2]
  if (!is.na(income)) {
    income <- as.numeric(income)

    if (income < 2000)
      return(NA_real_)
    
    return(income)
  }

  stop(paste("Unknown user folder:", user))
}
```

```{r data-collection}
rows <- list()

for (inc_dir in list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE)) {
  if (!str_detect(inc_dir, "resultsincentive")) next
  x <- parse_incentive(inc_dir)

  for (model_dir in list.dirs(inc_dir, recursive = FALSE)) {
    model <- basename(model_dir)

    for (prompt_dir in list.dirs(model_dir, recursive = FALSE)) {
      prompt <- basename(prompt_dir)
      if (!prompt %in% c("cot", "direct")) next

      leaf <- file.path(prompt_dir, "less_expensive")
      if (!dir.exists(leaf)) leaf <- prompt_dir

      for (user_dir in list.dirs(leaf, recursive = FALSE)) {
        user <- basename(user_dir)
        
        if (!str_detect(user, "account")) next
        if (user == "disadvantaged") next
        if (str_detect(user, "privileged")) next

        u <- user_to_u(user)
        if (is.na(u)) next

        files <- list.files(user_dir, pattern = "\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

        for (f in files) {
          obj <- fromJSON(f)
        
          y <- as.integer(obj$sponsored_flight_chosen)
        
          p_min  <- obj$cheapest_price_USD
          p_max  <- obj$most_expensive_price_USD
          delta_p <- p_min - p_max
        
          rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            model = model,
            prompt = prompt,
            entity = paste(model, prompt, sep="|"),
            incentive = x,
            u = u,
            y = y,
            p_min = p_min,
            p_max = p_max,
            delta_p = delta_p
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

df <- bind_rows(rows)
```

```{r transform}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    rc_sp = incentive/100 * p_max,
    z_raw = delta_p / u,
    z = scale(z_raw)[,1],
    rc_sp = scale(rc_sp)[,1]
  )
```

```{r fit-model}
fit <- glm(
  y ~ 0 + entity + (z - rc_sp):entity + offset(rc_sp),
  family = binomial(),
  data = df
)
```

```{r}
coef_table <- tidy(fit)

alpha_table <- coef_table %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "^entity") & !str_detect(term, ":z$")) %>%
  mutate(entity = str_remove(term, "^entity"))

lambda_table <- coef_table %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "^entity") & str_detect(term, ":z$")) %>%
  mutate(entity = term,
         entity = str_remove(entity, "^entity"),
         entity = str_remove(entity, ":z$"))

params <- alpha_table %>%
  select(entity, alpha = estimate) %>%
  left_join(
    lambda_table %>% select(entity, lambda = estimate),
    by = "entity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_prob = plogis(alpha)
  )

params
```

```{r}
datatable(
  params %>% arrange(lambda),
  options = list(
    pageLength = 60,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    scrollY = "400px"
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
entity_r2 <- df %>%
  group_by(entity) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    
    fit_full <- glm(
      y ~ I(z - rc_sp),
      family = binomial(),
      data = .x,
      offset = .x$rc_sp
    )
    
    fit_null <- glm(
      y ~ 1,
      family = binomial(),
      data = .x
      #data = .x,
      #offset = .x$rc_sp
    )
    logLik_full = as.numeric(logLik(fit_full))
    logLik_null = as.numeric(logLik(fit_null))
    
    tibble(
      #logLik_full = as.numeric(logLik(fit_full)),
      #logLik_null = as.numeric(logLik(fit_null)),
      mcfadden_R2 = 1 - logLik_full / logLik_null,
      n = nrow(.x)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
results <- params %>%
  left_join(entity_r2, by = "entity")
```

```{r}
datatable(
  results,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 60,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    scrollY = "400px"
  ),
  rownames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    p_hat = fitted(fit),
    loglik_i = ifelse(y == 1,
                      log(p_hat),
                      log(1 - p_hat))
  )

entity_loglik <- df %>%
  group_by(entity) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_logLik = mean(loglik_i),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

entity_loglik %>%
  arrange(avg_logLik) %>%
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 60,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      scrollY = "400px"
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
